text.en: People in other parts of the world know Canada as a country that is strong and free.
text.fr: Ailleurs dans le monde, on connaît le Canada comme un pays fort et libre.

source.quote: Canada is known around the world as a strong and free country.

verification.evidence: Canada is known around the world as a strong and free country.

text.en: Canadians have received, from those who came before, a constitutional tradition that has run without a break for longer than any other in the world.
text.fr: Les Canadiens ont reçu de ceux qui les ont précédés une tradition constitutionnelle qui dure sans interruption depuis plus longtemps que toute autre au monde.

source.quote: We have inherited the oldest continuous constitutional tradition in the world.

verification.evidence: We have inherited the oldest continuous constitutional tradition in the world.

text.en: In all of North America, Canada is the one country that is a constitutional monarchy.
text.fr: De tous les pays d'Amérique du Nord, le Canada est le seul à être une monarchie constitutionnelle.

source.quote: We are the only constitutional monarchy in North America.

verification.evidence: We are the only constitutional monarchy in North America.

text.en: Poets and songwriters have praised Canada by calling it the “Great Dominion.”
text.fr: Des poètes et des auteurs de chansons ont célébré le Canada en l'appelant le « Grand Dominion ».

source.quote: poets and songwriters have hailed Canada as the “Great Dominion.”

verification.evidence: poets and songwriters have hailed Canada as the “Great Dominion.”
